items.title: Vince DiMartino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 8, 2025
items.q: I wish I’d met him. Now that’s the guy I wish I’d met.

ctx.x: I wish I’d met him. Now that’s the guy I wish I’d met.
Yeah. He was marvelous. And people — these people I’m describing, every time their name comes up people always have a, “Ohhh, Joe Wilder” or “Ohhh, Clark Terry.”
